newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rohm shares fall after gloomy earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: Rohm shares fall after gloomy earnings forecast.

text.p: Rohm Co Ltd shares fell on Wednesday on the Osaka Securities Exchange after the company announced a gloomy earnings forecast, brokers said.
At 0430 GMT, the shares were down 170 yen at 6,470 yen.

On Tuesday, the integrated circuit maker said that its parent current profit was forecast to fall to 40.00 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1997 from 42.37 billion in the previous year. Previously, the company forecast a parent current profit of 43.00 billion.
